pairs.why: The two are almost the same; A's bigger, bolder fire and logs fill the card a little more like the real hero objects, but the gap is tiny.
A's logs are darker and glossier, close to the 'statue' look; B's softer, matte painted wood and stones sit closer to the real cauldron card.
B gives the log ends cartoon spiral rings and busier surface detail, the 'too texture-y' direction; A's simpler log ends read more like the real campfire.
A has the swirly ring texture on the log ends and a busier layout; B is smoother and cleaner, matching the real cards' moderate finish.
B's pebble-smooth stones, flatter light and stylized red roof feel more toy-like; A's shading and wood match the painterly real cards better.
A repeats the spiral end-grain texture and a cramped crop; B's cleaner logs and balanced composition fit the real cards better.
Nearly the same; A's smaller stone ring and slightly flatter fire read a bit weaker, so B is marginally closer.
A's flatter, more saturated glow and squashed fire ring look less solid; B's rounded logs and stones with soft light match the real finish better.
